lines.zh: 缓慢地移动着长脖子，寻找食物。
lines.en: Slowly moving its long neck, searching for food.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻摆动，警惕周围环境。
lines.en: Swinging its tail gently, wary of its surroundings.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，啃食低处的植物。
lines.en: Opening its large mouth to nibble at low-lying plants.

lines.zh: 缓缓地向前走，显得十分稳重。
lines.en: Moving forward slowly, with great poise.

lines.zh: 悠然地吃着地上的叶子。
lines.en: Chomping on the leaves on the ground leisurely.

lines.zh: 用尾巴扫开障碍物，继续前行。
lines.en: Using its tail to clear obstacles, continuing forward.

lines.zh: 低着头，寻找地面的植物。
lines.en: Lowering its head to search for plants on the ground.

lines.zh: 长脖子一伸一缩，寻找食物。
lines.en: Extending and retracting its long neck to find food.

lines.zh: 缓缓转身，观察周围的动静。
lines.en: Slowly turning to observe its surroundings.
Strolling leisurely, basking in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 长脖子扫过树冠，叶落了。
lines.en: My long neck sweeps the canopy; leaves fall.
Each tread sinks the ground a little.

lines.zh: 尾巴末端甩出一道弧线。
lines.en: My tail tip draws an arc behind me.
I edge around the boulder.

lines.zh: 我停下，把脖子伸向高处。
lines.en: I stop and stretch my neck high.

lines.zh: 背脊骨节一格一格起伏。
lines.en: The ridges on my back rise and fall.

lines.zh: 走路的声音像远处的闷雷。
lines.en: My steps sound like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地躺着，享受午后阳光。
lines.en: Lying lazily, basking in the afternoon sun.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，守护自己的领地。
lines.en: Standing quietly, guarding its territory.

lines.zh: 轻轻地摇晃着尾巴，放松自己。
lines.en: Gently swaying its tail to relax.

lines.zh: 抬头望天，享受宁静的时光。
lines.en: Raising its head to enjoy the quiet time.

lines.zh: 静静地咀嚼着树叶，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Chewing on leaves quietly, enjoying a moment of peace.

lines.zh: 悠然自得地躺着，晒着太阳。
lines.en: Lying contentedly, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 低头看着自己的蹄子，享受片刻平静。
lines.en: Lowering its head to look at its hooves, enjoying a moment of calm.
Standing quietly, looking into the distance.

lines.zh: 懒散地躺着，享受温暖的阳光。
lines.en: Lying lazily, soaking up the warm sunlight.

lines.zh: 静静地晒着太阳，享受宁静。
lines.en: Quietly basking in the sun, enjoying the serenity.

lines.zh: 半闭着眼，反刍嘴里的叶子。
lines.en: Half-closed eyes, chewing the cud.

lines.zh: 把下巴搁在树干上歇着。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a tree trunk.
My tail lazily flicks the flies.
Wind passes between my ribs.
I wait for the sun to move onto my back.

lines.zh: 长脖子一扬，警惕地盯着玩家。
lines.en: Raising its long neck, watching the player警惕地盯着。

lines.zh: 尾部一摆，似乎要驱赶玩家。
lines.en: Swinging its tail, as if to drive the player away.

lines.zh: 低头观察，似乎在思考对策。
lines.en: Lowering its head to observe, as if thinking of a对策。
Slowly turning its head towards the player.

lines.zh: 长脖子一伸，似乎想靠近玩家。
lines.en: Extending its long neck, as if to approach the player.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家，发出警告声。
lines.en: Staring at the player with warning sounds.

lines.zh: 用鼻子嗅了嗅，似乎闻到了玩家的气息。
lines.en: Sniffing, as if it detects the player's scent.

lines.zh: 低头看着玩家，似乎在评估情况。
lines.en: Lowering its head to look at the player, assessing the situation.

lines.zh: 缓慢地转过头，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Slowly turning its head towards the player.

lines.zh: 长脖子轻轻一动，似乎在试探玩家。
lines.en: Gently moving its long neck, as if probing the player.

lines.zh: 脖子先动，眼睛才落到你身上。
lines.en: My neck turns first; then my eyes find you.
You barely reach my knees.

lines.zh: 这片树是我的，你走错路了。
lines.en: These trees are mine; you took a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 我低头，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I lower my head and look you over.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，草地就安静了。
lines.en: The meadow quiets as you come near.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是不想让路。
lines.en: I am not afraid; I simply will not move.

lines.zh: 我扬起脖子，越过树顶看你。
lines.en: I raise my neck and look at you over the treetops.

lines.zh: 我一眼就看见了你的弓。
lines.en: I spotted your bow at once.

lines.zh: 蹄声会先告诉我你来了。
lines.en: Hoofbeats will tell me you are coming.
Look up and meet my eyes.

lines.zh: 梁龙负伤，发出痛苦的低吼。
lines.en: The Diplodocus groans in pain.

lines.zh: 巨龙受了伤，挣扎着爬行。
lines.en: The Diplodocus struggles to move.

lines.zh: 梁龙步履蹒跚，它受了伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus limps, wounded.

lines.zh: 梁龙缓慢移动，显然受了伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus moves slowly, clearly injured.
The Diplodocus moans in pain.

lines.zh: 梁龙的伤势让它的步伐沉重。
lines.en: The Diplodocus’s injury makes its steps heavy.
The Diplodocus shuffles forward.

lines.zh: 梁龙的伤让它行动迟缓。
lines.en: The Diplodocus moves slowly due to its injuries.
The Diplodocus emits a hoarse cry.
The Diplodocus struggles to move.
This grass smells good.
Time for a good meal.
That grass won't fill one bite.
This grassland is mine.
Those fern fronds are mine to eat first.
Eat some grass for energy.
Come here, feed me.
Your grass isn't enough.
Stay back, or I'll eat you.
I need more food!

lines.zh: 这棵树的嫩叶刚好够一口。
lines.en: This tree's young leaves are one mouthful.
Put down that handful of leaves.
My imprint knows you; do not pretend otherwise.
Climb on; my back is wide enough.

lines.zh: 饿了这么久，草地终于绿了。
lines.en: After so long hungry, the grass is green again.

lines.zh: 你给的树枝比野生的甜。
lines.en: The branch you offer is sweeter than wild ones.
Do not stand so far off; I do not eat people.
Watch out, I'm attacking.
Get out of my way.
I'm going to crash into you.
Back off, or it's dangerous.
You're too close!
You are standing by my hind leg.

lines.zh: 我这么长的脖子，绕不过去。
lines.en: With a neck this long, I cannot go around.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子一转就撞到你。
lines.en: One turn of my long neck and it hits you.
Move, I'm moving!
One swing of my long neck — back away.
Found a mate!
Time to mate.
My mate is beautiful.
I slow my steps and wait for you to come close.

lines.zh: 这伴侣我护定了，脖子都横过来了。
lines.en: I will guard this mate; my neck is already across.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子横过来，护着你。
lines.en: I lay my long neck across to shield you.
I'll protect you.
My mate is important.
Let's be together.
One stretch of my neck reaches the treetops.
Rumbled, here I come!
Smell the food!
This is my territory!
I take a bite and grind it slowly.

lines.zh: 长尾巴一圈，把它圈住了。
lines.en: One loop of my long tail and it is caught.
Fell bones, take them!
Cub, come to me!
I nudge it to you with my snout.
I have pinned this little thing under my foot.
Share food, we coexist!

lines.zh: 我的长脖子已经甩过来了。
lines.en: My long neck is already swinging around.
Found you, eating you now!

lines.zh: 我的视力很好，你逃不掉！
lines.en: My sight is good, you can't escape!
Be careful, my attack is strong!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会追上你！
lines.en: You can't escape, I'll catch you!
My attack will make you tremble!
I need your heart!
When I lift a foot, the ground shakes.
Don't run, I'll catch you!
Enjoy my attack!
Focus, target acquired!
Target, aim, shoot!
My aim is precise!
Target locked, one hit kill!
Target, don't panic!
Focus, aim!
My attack is flawless!
Target, aim, hit!
Stay focused, don't miss!
Target, precise!
Rumble and swing your tail!

lines.zh: 用力一蹬，发出震耳巨响！
lines.en: Kick hard, making a loud noise!
Swing your long neck to bite!

lines.zh: 用牙齿发出嘶嘶声，准备进攻！
lines.en: Sssss, getting ready to attack!
Tail swish, brushing off the enemy!
Stretches its neck, intimidating the opponent!
Roars and approaches the prey!

lines.zh: 用粗壮的后腿撞向敌人！
lines.en: Kick with strong hind legs!

lines.zh: 用尾巴勾住猎物，拉向自己！
lines.en: Hook with the tail, pull the prey!
Open wide, bite the prey!
Slowly crawl out of the ground!
The hatchling hatches!
Slowly walking from afar!
Rise slowly from the hole!
Break the soil and start walking!
Climb out of the rock layer slowly!
Peek out of the sand slowly!
Hatchling hatches in the egg!
Hatchling breaks through the ground!
Slowly emerge from underground!

lines.zh: 巨大的影子先落在草地上。
lines.en: A huge shadow reaches the grass first.

lines.zh: 我从河谷的雾里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the river valley's mist.

lines.zh: 整片树林晃了一下，我到了。
lines.en: The whole grove sways; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 地上多出一串深坑脚印。
lines.en: A line of pit-deep footprints appears.

lines.zh: 梁龙的皮肤被火焰灼伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus’s skin is burned by fire.
The Diplodocus falls from a cliff.

lines.zh: 梁龙被淹死后浮上水面。
lines.en: The Diplodocus floats after drowning.

lines.zh: 梁龙被爆炸的冲击波震伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus is injured by the explosion’s shockwave.
The Diplodocus is injured by an arrow.

lines.zh: 梁龙受到魔法攻击，身上有伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus is injured by magical attacks.
The Diplodocus is weak from starvation.

lines.zh: 梁龙被闪电击中，身上有伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus is struck by lightning, injured.

lines.zh: 梁龙跌入虚空，受到致命伤。
lines.en: The Diplodocus falls into the void, critically injured.
